text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"WOOOOOOOO! This year was sooo hype, too!! 
The Derby really is the best!!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly, I was wondering how this year 
would turn out... but this is what the 
Derby is all about, baby!!"

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... was truly amazing...! I'm so 
proud to be from the same generation...!!

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: ............I wanted to run, too.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...Sfira.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
""STIN"... Yet, this is very... "gentle", 
isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Sounds of Earth... I'm rooting for you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Bravissimo...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(It truly was... magnificent music...! So 
much so that I wished time would stand 
still forever—)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: (And yet... my intuition told me.)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(I... we can...! Create an even more 
wonderful session! That possibility has 
opened up right now!!)

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: ――Earth.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, my friend! Grazie for such a 
magnificent melody...!!

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: ......That's my line.

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
Because Earth conveyed my... conveyed our 
feelings—

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
I think I—and probably everyone else— gave 
it our absolute all today with no regrets.

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: So... um... thank you, truly.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...I simply did what I wanted to do. If 
everyone was able to give it their all, 
that was purely through their own 
strength."

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text: ...Haha. That's so like Earth.

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
...Let's keep having great races like 
today's going forward, okay? It's a 
promise.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Molto bene!! Ah, it's a promise...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Direttore!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Direttrice!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment Sounds of Earth and I returned 
to the waiting room, we started a jam 
session, pouring out our overflowing 
emotions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Today's race was so thrilling that 
nothing less could possibly calm me down—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Competing for the pinnacle of their 
generation, everyone unleashing all the 
power they possess, clashing in the finest 
display of running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today's Derby was magnificent, packed with 
everything that makes racing so thrilling.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the fact that Sounds of Earth was one 
of the runners who fired up that race 
brings me more joy than anything else...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the same time, that is precisely why I 
believe. If it's Sounds of Earth, 
surely...—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. I'm sure you've just come to 
the same realization as I have.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I felt it through your music just now...! 
Now, try putting that into words...!
choice_data_list: —Let's aim for an even greater session!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The potential of an Umamusume named Sounds 
of Earth does not end with this Nippon 
Derby. If anything, this is just the 
beginning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She can create it. An even greater race 
than today's— the greatest race no one has 
ever seen before...!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Benissimo!!! You truly are the best, 
Direttore!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Benissimo!!! You truly are the best, 
Direttrice!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right! Together, I know we can 
create an even greater session!! Let us 
strive for it side by side!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
What should we do for now...!? If she's 
running next, then surely—
choice_data_list: Of course, it's the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Sounds of Earth's running today, I 
was convinced she could contend in the 
Kikuka-sho—the final 3,000m jewel of the 
Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having seen her run in the Derby, racing 
fans must have high hopes for Sounds of 
Earth in the Kikuka Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Okay, it's settled then...! Our next stage 
will be the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Alright, there's so much to do again! 
Let's make sure to enjoy every moment!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Sounds of Earth's next target race 
was decided to be the Kikuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...One night, a few days later.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. Your eyes are exceptionally 
passionate tonight. Just what kind of 
story are you going to tell me?

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: ...It's a challenge in my own way.

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
—I will definitely run with you at the 
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text:
I may not be good enough right now, but... 
I'll gain strength over the summer and 
rack up real results, just watch me!!

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: So wait for me. Until the moment I arrive!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Sì, certo! I'll be waiting—and enriching 
my own sound while I do.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to performing with 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Embracing all that was changing, the 
seasons marched on toward summer, and the 
Kikuka Sho that lay beyond—
